sloka: जयत्यतिबलो रामो लक्ष्मणश्च महाबलः ।राजा जयति सुग्रीवो राघवेणाभिपालितः ।। ५.५९.२३ ।।।।
transliteration: jayatyatibalo rāmo lakṣmaṇaśca mahābalaḥ ।rājā jayati sugrīvo rāghaveṇābhipālitaḥ ।। 5.59.23 ।।।।

translations.english: "Mighty Rama and Lakshmana and King Sugriva protected by Rama are renowned for their valour. I am Hanuman, son of the Windgod, a servant of Rama. This I announced.
translations.hindi: तभी तो वे सब वानर आकर मधुपान कर रहे हैं । हे पुरुषश्रेष्ठ ! बिना सौता को देखे वे विख्यात वानर लोग
